fields.name: Marvel Rivals
fields.description: Marvel Rivals is a 6v6 player-versus-player, third-person hero shooter title.[11] With the right combination of two or three characters, players can make use of "Dynamic Hero Synergy" which further maximize their playable character's combat efficiency.

fields.name: Minecraft
fields.description: A sandbox game where players can explore, mine resources, craft, and build in an open-world environment. Includes survival and creative modes.

fields.name: Call of Duty: Warzone
fields.description: A free-to-play battle royale mode within the Call of Duty series, featuring fast-paced combat and a variety of weapons and vehicles.

fields.name: The Witcher 3: Wild Hunt
fields.description: A sandbox game where players can explore, mine resources, craft, and build in an open-world environment. Includes survival and creative modes.

fields.name: Fortnite
fields.description: A free-to-play battle royale game where players fight to be the last one standing on an island. Includes building mechanics and seasonal updates.

fields.name: Resident Evil 4 (Remake)
fields.description: A remake of the classic 2005 survival horror game, where players control Leon S. Kennedy on a mission to rescue the U.S. president’s daughter from a mysterious cult in a rural Spanish village. It features updated graphics, mechanics, and intense combat sequences.

fields.name: Rust
fields.description: A multiplayer survival game where players must gather resources, build shelters, and fight against other players and the environment to survive. The game features an open-world setting and a strong focus on PvP interactions.

fields.name: Hell Divers
fields.description: A top-down, cooperative twin-stick shooter set in a dystopian future where players control elite soldiers known as Helldivers, fighting to defend humanity against alien threats. The game emphasizes teamwork, strategic combat, and intense action.

fields.name: Hell Divers 2
fields.description: The sequel to Helldivers, Helldivers 2 continues the co-op, twin-stick shooter experience with a more immersive, dynamic combat system. Players will face off against dangerous alien species in larger, more complex battlefields, emphasizing teamwork and strategic play.

fields.name: Cyber Punk 2077
fields.description: A futuristic open-world RPG set in the sprawling city of Night City, with immersive storytelling and advanced cybernetic enhancements.

fields.name: Elden Ring
fields.description: An action RPG from the creators of Dark Souls, set in a vast, mysterious world filled with danger and lore.

fields.name: Red Dead Redemption 2
fields.description: A cinematic open-world game set in the Wild West, with breathtaking visuals and a compelling story.

fields.name: Terraria
fields.description: A sandbox adventure game with crafting, building, and exploration in a 2D pixel art world.

fields.name: Dark Souls III
fields.description: A challenging action RPG with punishing difficulty, intricate lore, and gothic fantasy settings.

fields.name: Overwatch 2
fields.description: A fast-paced multiplayer hero shooter with unique characters and engaging team-based gameplay.

fields.name: League of Legends
fields.description: A competitive MOBA game where players choose champions and battle in teams to destroy the enemy nexus.

fields.name: Valorant
fields.description: A tactical first-person shooter with a focus on precise aim and character abilities.

fields.name: Hollow Knight
fields.description: A beautifully hand-drawn Metroidvania game where you explore a vast, interconnected underground kingdom full of secrets and challenges.

fields.name: Battlefield 2042
fields.description: A large-scale multiplayer first-person shooter set in a near-future world ravaged by climate disasters. Players engage in epic battles with dynamic weather and destructible environments.
